authoritative_split.source: accepted dataset manifests and their independent gates

assignment_rules: Use the accepted design-level assignments exactly; do not regenerate or re-stratify them.
A design and all five realization runs are indivisible and must remain in one split.
No design_id, run_id, run_key, or design/realization pair may overlap between splits.
The RF and TGNN experiments use the same semantic split assignments and target mappings.
The 11 ordered temporal snapshots of each TGNN run are indivisible and remain within that run's split.

validation: TGNN early stopping and checkpoint selection
classification threshold confirmation under the pre-frozen rule
test: sealed-index identity and integrity checks only before authorization
one final evaluation after one-time authorization

prohibited_usage_before_test_authorizati: test targets or target-bearing test source artifacts

test_targets_opened_only_after: all four model specifications are frozen
all four selected configurations are recorded
final repeated-seed model weights are frozen
training and validation artifacts are no longer eligible for selection changes
final_test_boundary.post_opening_change_policy: No model, preprocessing, threshold, architecture, or hyperparameter changes are permitted.

no_merge_policy: Train and validation are never merged for this Stage A evaluation protocol; final models remain training-fitted with validation-only selection/early stopping.
sealed_test_requirements: Only the target-free sealed test index may be inspected before authorization.
Test target paths and values must not be opened, loaded, parsed, or materialized before authorization.
A failed or incomplete test evaluation is recorded as incomplete; it is not repaired by retuning or rerunning after results are opened.
